title: Claude Code subagent frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of .claude/agents/<name>.md, the canonical definition of every Maxwell subagent (the OpenCode mirror is generated from it). Human-authored: no schemaVersion, kind or provenance. x-maxwell is mandatory: role and workflows record which workflows may spawn the agent, and the AGENTS.md rule that runtime probes are read-only is enforced three ways: a name starting with runtime-probe- must carry role runtime-probe, role runtime-probe must use such a name, and role runtime-probe requires readOnlyTargets true and only runtime-probe-* workflows. Claude Code also accepts an experimental block; Maxwell refuses it so audit runs stay reproducible

examples.name: iac-auditor
examples.description: Static probe of Terraform, Pulumi, Helm and Kubernetes manifests in a target application's repos. Use for probe-iac and probe-app-chart to find misconfigurations mapped to SEBI CSCRF, RBI Directions 2026 and CIS benchmarks. Read-only: never applies changes

name.description: Agent identifier; must equal the file name without .md and is the name workflows use to spawn it. Names starting with runtime-probe- are reserved for role runtime-probe

description.description: When to delegate to this agent and what it returns. The main agent reads this to choose subagents, so state the workflows it serves and whether it is read-only

tools.description: Allow-list of tools as a comma-separated string or a YAML list of 'Tool' / 'Tool(specifier)' entries. Omit to inherit every tool; Maxwell agents always list tools explicitly so the mirror can derive an OpenCode permission map

disallowedTools.description: Tools removed from the inherited or listed set; same shape as tools

model.description: Model alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, fable, inherit) or a full claude-* model id; the mirror maps aliases to provider/model ids

permissionMode.description: Permission mode the subagent runs under. bypassPermissions skips the Maxwell hooks and is reserved for validators that never write

maxTurns.description: Upper bound on agentic turns before the subagent is stopped

skills.description: Skills (directory names under .claude/skills) preloaded into the agent's context

mcpServers.description: MCP servers connected while the agent runs, by reference to servers configured in opencode.json / .mcp.json. Inline server definitions are refused because server commands and {env:} secret references must live in one reviewed place

hooks.description: Agent-level hooks; Claude Code supports PreToolUse, PostToolUse and Stop (converted to SubagentStop) here, each with the same matcher groups as settings.json

memory.description: Scope of the agent's persistent memory directory: user (~/.claude), project (.claude, committed) or local (.claude, git-ignored)

background.description: When true the agent runs in the background and the caller is notified on completion

isolation.description: worktree runs the agent in a separate git worktree so its edits cannot touch the caller's tree

color.description: Colour used for the agent in the terminal UI

initialPrompt.description: First user turn submitted automatically when the agent runs as the main session (claude --agent <name>); workflows pass the task in the spawn call instead, so this is only for interactive use

x-maxwell.description: Maxwell metadata not interpreted by Claude Code

xMaxwell.description: Role of the agent in the Maxwell pipeline, the workflows that may spawn it, the workspace paths it may write, whether it is read-only against target systems, and the instruments it specialises in. Agents with role runtime-probe must set readOnlyTargets true and may only serve runtime-probe-* workflows

role.description: context gathers company/app facts; static-probe reads repos and manifests; runtime-probe queries live systems read-only; planner drafts initiatives; author writes suggestion diffs; reviewer critiques; reporter writes summary sections; validator checks outputs

workflows.description: Workflows allowed to spawn this agent; probe-agent-graph builds the agent graph from it and the KPI scripts reconcile it with provenance.workflow/agent. Empty or absent means any workflow may spawn the agent

writes.description: Workspace paths or globs the agent may create or modify; empty means the agent only returns text to its caller

readOnlyTargets.description: True when the agent never mutates target systems or repositories (required true for runtime probes)

regulatoryFocus.description: Instruments the agent maps its findings to first
